script.description: dry-run only: the whole declarative tour script from vis_guide with tour.

tourId.description: look and dry-run, optional: the tour to use; reuse the look's tourId for the dry run so it starts signed in.

source.description: look only: the source the script will name.

sites.description: look only, optional: the script's sites.

signIn.description: look only, optional: the script's signIn, when known.

signInRoute.description: look only, optional, before signIn is known: the sign-in page's route; the look lists that page signed out.

pages.description: look only: up to 10 {route, actions?} (actions: a list for both sizes, or {desktop?, phone?}); [] with signInRoute lists only the sign-in page.

dryRunId.description: record only: the job id of a successful dry run.

jobId.description: status, cancel, inspect and check: the job id.

capture.description: inspect only, optional: an exact capture filename from the report.

overviewReviewed.description: true only after actually looking at every overview cell.

suspiciousCapturesReviewed.description: Every capture you opened closely, including each reported suspicious one.
